history.title: The heart behind the story.
intro: My name is Leah and I founded Eleven Stories, a France & International press relations agency dedicated to the world of luxury lifestyle.
I support brands, houses, places and creators in growing their visibility and their image, in France and abroad.

Hospitality, restaurants, fine jewellery, fashion, beauty, cosmetics, design, art de vivre… Eleven Stories moves at the crossroads of worlds guided by the same standard: a strong identity, a singular savoir-faire and a story worth telling.

My role is to turn that identity into a narrative that is true, desirable and relevant — one that sparks interest among media, journalists, editors-in-chief, stylists, tastemakers and content creators.
history.pull: Finding the right angle. The right message. The right moment. And above all, the right voices.
vision: With more than 6 years of experience in international press relations for a premium house, I wanted to create a human-sized agency, able to support every project with genuine closeness.
Eleven Stories is built on a deeply bespoke approach. There is no standard strategy: each engagement is shaped around the brand's identity, its ambitions, its news and the markets it wants to reach.
world: Based in Toulouse and resolutely open to the world, I run campaigns in France and abroad. This dual dimension is at the heart of my approach: understanding a project as closely as possible — its territory, its teams, its identity — while giving it resonance beyond its borders.
Over the years, my network has grown among journalists, editors-in-chief, stylists, tastemakers and talents, here and elsewhere.

Because press relations are also built in the field, I place great importance on meeting people: media appointments, press days, openings, launches, events, trade fairs, press trips and support abroad.
I see communication as an ecosystem in which press relations, influence, image, events and international development speak to one another coherently.
history.closing: Eleven Stories is a vision of press relations that is demanding, human, agile and open to the world.
history.signature: You create the exceptional. I give it the echo it deserves, here and everywhere.

sections.title: Data controller
sections.text: The data controller for data collected on this site is Eleven Stories, represented by Leah Colomer, who can be reached at elevenstories.pr@gmail.com.

sections.title: Data collected
sections.text: Through the "Let's talk" form, we collect the information you choose to share with us: full name, email address, phone number, target area, industry and the content of your message.

sections.title: Purpose and legal basis
sections.text: This data is used solely to respond to your request and, where relevant, to discuss your project with you. Processing is based on your consent, given by ticking the box provided before submitting the form.

sections.title: Recipients
sections.text: Your data is intended exclusively for Eleven Stories. It is never sold or passed on to third parties. Messages are delivered by our email provider (Resend) and the site is hosted by Vercel, both acting as processors.

sections.title: Retention period
sections.text: Data is kept for as long as necessary to handle your request, and for a maximum of 3 years from our last exchange.

sections.title: Analytics and cookies
sections.text: This site uses Vercel Analytics, a privacy-friendly audience measurement tool that sets no cookies and collects no data that can identify you. No advertising or tracking cookies are used, which is why no consent banner is displayed.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict and object to the processing of your data, as well as the right to data portability. You may withdraw your consent at any time. To exercise these rights, write to elevenstories.pr@gmail.com. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).
